completionGuarantee.authority: Explicit human requirement: it must always remain possible to complete the overall main mission.
completionGuarantee.invariant: For every living playable commander and every unearned required source, at least one eligible original, renewed or continuity-inquiry path is reachable. Ordinary failure, destruction, cancellation, spending, crime, missed windows, source depletion and save/load must never permanently disable all paths.
independentOf: survival of a named person or original station
completionGuarantee.whatRemains: Original failure, dead people, destroyed station, lost cargo, criminal record, debt and original fee/bonus consequences persist. No old objective or rescue is retrospectively marked successful. This guarantees an available completable route, not automatic success or immunity from another failed attempt. Standard commander death/game-over rules are separate.

continuityInquiry.kind: new independent space/station commission, never a reset or a failed-case success
continuityInquiry.offeredWhen: Any required clue is unearned and the original or fully funded renewed task is unavailable, failed or declined. It is also always requestable from the clue journal, without needing to exhaust replacement attempts.
continuityInquiry.entry: Clue journal > missing source > Request continuity inquiry. Show known source and new investigation, preserve spoiler restrictions. The normal docked contract board exposes the same request, with no rank, reputation or cash gate. The clue journal and charter request exist from a fresh commander, before any clue or PLUGH discovery.
continuityInquiry.service: A chartered orbital evidence service has a receiving desk at every operational main station. When a station is destroyed, keep the saved case and route the desk to a surviving orbital station; if there is none reachable, a chartered orbital receiving tender visits the current playable system. It uses protected service quarters and cannot be a hostile mission target; it grants no invulnerable combat escort, trade stock or free equipment. Refusal by the original faction does not suppress it. Inquiry data receiving does not require passenger/cargo transfer or doorway-compatible docking with the tender; use actual authenticated short-range station-authorised comms from the player craft. Protected service capability does not protect the player from ordinary danger.
continuityInquiry.preservedBasis: Before publishing any base-source offer, preserve three independently signed non-private source observations in separate charter archive replicas, with hashes, origin, consent, time, last-known world and the undisclosed inward-trace measurement. Archives are genuine pre-offer records, not retroactively invented surviving people/property. Replicas and completion receipts belong to the durable main-quest evidence service and are never combat entities. They contain enough independent provenance for a later inquiry, but have no player clue receipt and reveal no future finale instruction.

stages.objective: At the orbital desk, open a new source-linked inquiry and obtain a zero-mass signed survey mandate and three archive measurement challenges.
stages.gate: No fee, cargo, cabin, source-stock, faction or historical-success requirement. Do not grant clue.

stages.objective: Fly to three registered non-consumable external reference beacons in the current ordinary system; perform source-specific measurements and reconcile them with the independent archived observations.
stages.gate: Use baseline flight controls and ship instruments; no specialist purchased fitting, cargo or person required. The service installs/maintains the actual beacons from its existing station apparatus. Each carries a new case-specific challenge, so an old scan receipt cannot qualify.

stages.objective: Operate a source-specific physical test arrangement on those beacons and pass its measurable consistency/safety test.
stages.gate: Purely non-consumable calibration apparatus; restart a failed trial locally. It cannot create people, repair the original disaster, award a combat kill or claim original mission success.

stages.objective: Bring the signed measured results to a different authorised desk operator. Reconcile at least two independently corroborated records and explicitly record the original loss/outcome.
stages.gate: Correct source, actual case, three new measurements, passing functional test and real orbital receiving. Records alone, payment or failure are insufficient.

stages.objective: Commit the new verified inquiry outcome and the same source clue receipt once.
stages.gate: No original fee, bounty, rank, faction reward, accreditation or equipment. This is an alternative way to learn the underlying trace, not another success of the failed combat/rescue/donation mission.

continuityInquiry.costPolicy: Zero credits, deposit, cargo or passenger places for the commander. The charter service performs the investigation as its standing public duty; only instrument use and data receiving are provided. It never issues saleable replacement kits, hulls or money. The finite-stock paid replacement option remains separate. No unfunded clone or recycled failed lifetime source pair is created.
continuityInquiry.retryPolicy: There is no attempt cap, clue destruction, hidden expiry or cumulative resource charge. Cancelled inquiry retains saved confirmed measurements, but no clue. Local failed tests reset only the non-consumable test apparatus, not the original world outcome. If original beacons are obstructed/lost, charter apparatus provides a new safe registered fixture with the same challenge and invalidates the old one.
continuityInquiry.savePolicy: Persist case ID, archive hashes, challenge, measurements, fixture identities, test state and receiving. Loading never replays rewards or changes the required source set.
continuityInquiry.scopeDecision: A successful continuity inquiry may learn a source clue without repeating a now-impossible combat, donation or rescue task. Original direct-success requirements and rewards remain intact. This new alternative explicitly supersedes the earlier no-pacifist-shortcut statement only for clue acquisition; it is necessary to satisfy unconditional main-quest recoverability.

objectiveCountExplanation: 64 five-step renewed/remedial tracks plus64 five-step guaranteed continuity-inquiry tracks;450 original objectives remain separately inventoried. These are parameterised alternative tracks, not128 new campaign stories or new clue IDs.

engineContract.owner: GameRuntime owns case state, physical measurements, archive provenance, loss history and atomic clue receipt. AppKit only requests a typed operation and renders snapshots.
engineContract.clueAuthority: A dedicated native charter-inquiry verifier is explicitly authorised for the64 listed source/clue pairs only after all five new-case steps. It may commit the original source clue receipt without setting original pack success or payment. Extend the closed production trust mapping for this verified domain; do not loosen original digest pins or let arbitrary packs emit authenticated completion.
engineContract.replayAndRefusal: Each operation validates current case/source/location and existing receipt set, computes on a proposed state and commits once. Wrong source, mixed case evidence, missing native producer, missing archive consent, wrong physical test or direct script completion must refuse with no mutation.
saveRequired: independent audit and final clue receipts
engineContract.nativeAcceptance: For each64source, test original failure/depletion/issuer loss/hostility/zero funds and non-consumable retry through ordinary UI, then save/reload before and after final commit. Assert reachable inquiry, no original success/fee/reward, correct one clue, no duplicate, and no script-forged receipt.
